title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A 3 by 3 board of grey tiles on a dark base. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left tile. A flat orange disc marks the goal on the top-right tile. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons (or arrow keys) move the token one tile. Hint shows a green arrow from the token pointing at a move that brings it one step closer to the goal. Readouts show moves made and steps left to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes the row or the column by one. The goal is 2 columns right and 2 rows up, so the shortest route is 4 moves.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
A move that would leave the board does nothing and is not counted. The hint arrow points right while a column remains, then up; it hides after your next move.
The start and goal squares are always the same; Reset returns the token to the same start and clears the move count.
